lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition U2In2Bi8 (reduced formula UInBi4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Bi-centered tetrahedral coordination (four neighbors: one Bi, three In or three U) and higher-coordinate Bi environments with 10 and 13 geometric neighbors. U centers show 16 neighbors (10 Bi, 6 In), while In centers are 8-coordinate toward Bi. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between tetrahedral Bi polyhedra and between Bi tetrahedra and In or U coordination polyhedra.
